name: Hellhounds of Candlemour
source:
"Release the Hounds, for there's trouble abound!"

While scouring the village of Candlemour for powerful artifacts to bring back to his evil masters, Houndmaster Jerimoth Shadowblood inadvertently finds himself thrust into the role of protector for a village he originally intended to destroy. Pursued by a creepy local legend known as the Woman of the Wood and a reluctant town-appointed Torchbearer named Daniel, Jerimoth (along with his loyal Hellhound, Rommy) traverses the town of Candlemour in search of  answers to the mysterious demone infestation that terrorizes the local townspeople. Little does Jerimoth know, his unexpected arrival has thrown a Hellhound-shaped-wrench in a sinister plot, and good and evil are not always as they seem… 

Who can Jerimoth trust? Where can he turn? Is the Candlemour Birdwatcher's Society really just birding? Your resolve will be tested in this exciting episodic visual novel.

[From [url=https://hellhoundsstudio.itch.io/hellhounds-of-candlemour]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“放猎犬！麻烦找上门了！”

驯犬师杰里莫斯·影血奉命搜遍烛沼村，要把强力遗物带回去献给邪恶的主人。谁知阴差阳错，他竟成了这座原打算毁掉的村庄的保护者。当地骇人传说中的“林中女子”追着他不放，镇上硬派来一位名叫丹尼尔的执炬人，也不情不愿地跟着他。杰里莫斯带着忠实的地狱猎犬罗米走遍烛沼，想弄清四处作祟、吓得居民不得安宁的恶魔究竟从何而来。他哪里知道，自己这只意外闯入的“地狱猎犬”已经搅乱了一桩险恶阴谋，而善恶也未必如表面所见…

杰里莫斯可以相信谁？又该向谁求助？烛沼观鸟协会当真只是看看鸟吗？这部分集推出的视觉小说，将考验你能否坚持自己的判断。

（来源：[url=https://hellhoundsstudio.itch.io/hellhounds-of-candlemour]itch.io[/url]）
